title: Leaving Dorsey after seven months; Buddy Rich replaces him
summary: Leeman quits in November, tired of one-nighters and strict time-keeping; Buddy Rich takes the drum chair and Charlie Barnet calls him.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: ... was responsible for a lot of wonderful, wonderful things.
And the band was working out beautiful, and that's when they get Lionel.

However, I was with the band six or seven months, and Tommy was strict upon leading with time, and I wanted some freedom -- I had had it with Shaw, with the strictness of watching somebody else. So this was the turning point, dramatically, for me -- was I quit the band in November, I didn't want to travel on one nighters any more, and Tommy was trying to sign everybody up to contracts, because the band changed inside of two months -- a complete different band entirely. And then he hired Buddy Rich to take my place. I quit and he got Buddy Rich, who had just broken up -- The Shaw band broke up eventually; that's when Shaw went to Mexico -- this was all history.
